description:
SMS message ID test vectors (SPEC §4.1): id = lowercase_hex(SHA-256(UTF8(sender + "
" + body + "
" + receivedAtEpochMillis))). Shared with the Android worker; expected IDs generated independently with Python hashlib. Bodies are synthetic.
